added_fixtures.discriminates: Must differ from DENSE_LOCAL_RAY_TARGETABLE, where a clear face exists.
added_fixtures.geometry: Target C fully enclosed by a shell of structurally distinct colliders on every axis. No admissible probe origin outside C's collision geometry has a clear segment to it under the declared probe policy.
added_fixtures.question: Can the gate say NOT_ISOLATABLE, or does it only ever find a working ray?
added_fixtures.why_known: The shell is placed by the fixture author on every face. A gate that only ever returns TARGET_ISOLATABLE has not added a stage, it has added a search that terminates when the answer looks right -- tuning the intervention to the observation. This fixture is the only thing that can catch that.

added_fixtures.geometry: The DENSE_LOCAL_RAY_TARGETABLE scene with the local probe frozen, then B's collision disabled. A and all other state held fixed.
added_fixtures.note: Isolates the two concepts: intervention adequacy vs causal observation.
added_fixtures.question: Does the dense pass still depend on the declared target existing?
added_fixtures.why_known: Targetability is a property of the intervention and should be unchanged by B's absence; the OBSERVATION must change. Preserving the causal-mutation discipline from the parent suite in the dense case, so the new fixtures cannot pass by correlation with geometry alone.

author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
no_hospital_content: No Hospital path, prim, distance or geometry is used. Hospital supplied the mechanism; the fixtures reproduce it from first principles.
reason: The frozen three fixtures cover the positive transition but cannot detect a gate that always finds some working ray. A targetability stage must be able to return TARGET_NOT_ISOLATABLE, and must preserve counterfactual dependence in dense geometry. Added before any execution, so no observation informed them.

structural_distinctness_precondition.requirement: physical_owner(A) != physical_owner(B); rigid_body(A) != rigid_body(B); prototype(A) != prototype(B)
structural_distinctness_precondition.why: Without this the dense fixture would silently become an identity-mapping test instead of a targetability test, and would pass for the wrong reason.

wrong_1_excluded: wrong_1 remains UNRESOLVED and is not evidence for any fixture here.
